agent_explanation: Thin vertical wall (w=0.3 at x=14..14.3, top y=8.3). Body falls with vx=-3.24 and grazes the top-right corner/side: distance goes +0.098 (step22) -> -0.051 (step23) -> -0.200 (step24) with vx,vy evolving only by gravity, i.e. no contact impulse or positional correction is ever applied. Face-on impact on the same wall bounces correctly (counterfactual), so the corner/side-contact path for a thin box is missed, letting the circle sink past the 0.15 limit.
